statement: This request authorizes immutable candidate publication and isolated image-level rehearsal only after first-Stable final acceptance was upgraded to schema version 2 and all six evidence artifacts—release, target runtime, recovery, provider, visual/device review, and actual GoreeCloud Browser runtime—became cryptographically bound, and after all eight source/evidence-contract gates passed on the exact reviewed base. It does not authorize production cutover, Stable promotion, target-host changes, compatibility-name retirement, or rollback-material deletion.
